scope.geography: India: central government, all states, all union territories

status_note: This is a production-oriented dataset starter package, not a complete populated dataset. No scheme is marked verified or approved. Bulk collection from myScheme is not included because its published terms prohibit bots/scrapers absent express written authorization.

preferred_sources: Official administering ministry/department scheme page or guidelines
Official state/UT department portal or government notification
data.gov.in dataset/API where the individual resource license/terms permit reuse
Authorized government data export/API with written permission where required
source_policy.myScheme: Discovery/reference only until written authorization or an expressly permitted data access method is obtained; do not bulk scrape/copy pages.
source_policy.secondary_sources: Use only to discover candidate schemes; do not use as the sole authority for eligibility, amounts, documents, or deadlines.
source_policy.no_inference: Do not infer eligibility thresholds, benefit amounts, documents, deadlines, or active status. Use null/unknown and send to review if official evidence is absent.
